newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar closes higher.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar closes higher.

text.p: White sugar futures ended the day higher after following a firmer New York market but volume of business remained relatively small, traders said.
In the absence of any fresh sugar related news technical factors such as charts appeared to be calling the tune, particularly in the U.S., they said.
Traders were watching the weather situation in East Europe where further rainfall threatened renewed flooding in beet growing Poland, but so far there has been limited impact on sugar markets.
At the close October was $2.50 a tonne up and turnover totalled 2,145 lots.
In Paris October 45 ICUMSA was down $0.50 at $321.00 a tonne and turnover was 106 lots and 100 ICUMSA was tradeless with October little changed.
